transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I've been struggling with eating massive amounts of food in one sitting, and I feel like I completely lose control and can't stop myself. This has been happening for almost two years now, and I'm just really overwhelmed and don't know what to do.
After these episodes of eating large amounts of food, do you ever try to get rid of the calories by vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Yes, I do all of those things because I'm so desperate not to gain weight after I overeat. I force myself to throw up, take laxatives, and spend hours exercising excessively even when my body is completely exhausted. It feels like the only way to undo what I've done.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were Binge-Eating Disorder and Bulimia Nervosa, but based on the patient's admission of regularly engaging in compensatory behaviors such as vomiting, using laxatives, and excessive exercise after binge eating, Bulimia Nervosa seems more likely. Binge-Eating Disorder does not typically involve these compensatory behaviors, making it less likely given the patient's description of their behaviors.
